stanza: If I am delirious
It's because you are harboring my tongue, my faithless tongue

delirious.line: That only showed bad taste, run around like you’re delirious
delirious.linePrev: For years I had grace, saw your mad face
delirious.lineNext: Foaming from the mouth like you’re furious

stanza: Downy sins of streetlight fancies
Chase the costumes she shall wear
Ermine furs adorned, imperious
Severin, Severin awaits you there
It's coming from the women and the men
Oh baby, we'll be making love again
We'll be going down so deep
The river's going to weep
And the mountain's going to shout Amen!
It's coming like the tidal flood
Beneath the lunar sway
Imperial, mysterious
In amorous array
Democracy is coming to the U.S.A

serious.line: And I could tell that you were serious
stanza: On the on-ramp, you said
"If you love me, you will listen to this song"
And I could tell that you were serious
So I didn't tell you you were driving the wrong way
On the interstate until the song was done
You felt like an idiot adding an hour to the drive
But it gave us more time to embarrass ourselves
Tellin' stories we wouldn't tell anyone else

serious.songTitle: By the Time It Gets Dark
serious.line: Why on earth should life be so serious?
stanza: Light up your face, baby, let's get going
Want to see a change in those weary eyes
We'll have some fun, take a boat out rowing
Why on earth should life be so serious?
